title: AnswerBundle
description: Block 1 -> Block 3 interface. Output of the RAG QA system (Program 2). v1.1: adds optional `retrieved` (all retrieved passages D) and optional `schema_version`; backward compatible with v1.0.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract the bundle was produced against. Optional for backward compatibility; producers should set it (current: "1.1").

retrieved.description: Optional (v1.1). All passages D returned by the retriever, cited or not; used for `nearest` alignment and WARN decisions.
